name: factorial-stops-one-early
why: the loop stops at n - 1.

edits.old: for (unsigned i = 2; i <= n; ++i) result *= i;
edits.new: for (unsigned i = 2; i < n; ++i) result *= i;

name: factorial-wraps-around
why: no guard: 21! silently wraps around in 64 bits.

edits.old: if (n > 20) return 0;  // 21! does not fit in 64 bits

name: factorial-guard-one-late
why: the guard starts at 22.

name: fnv-signed-characters
why: the char is XORed as a (signed) char: bytes above 127 are sign-extended.

edits.old: hash ^= static_cast<unsigned char>(*text);  // an unsigned byte: a negative char would be sign-extended

name: fnv-wrong-start-value
why: the offset basis is wrong.

name: fnv-wrong-prime
why: the multiplier is wrong.

name: fnv-multiplies-before-xor
why: FNV-1 (multiply, then XOR) instead of FNV-1a.

edits.old:
hash ^= static_cast<unsigned char>(*text);  // an unsigned byte: a negative char would be sign-extended
        hash *= 16777619u;

name: fnv-only-constexpr
why: constexpr instead of consteval: it may now run at run time, and nothing forces compile-time use.

name: fnv-stops-before-the-last-character
why: the loop ends one character early.

name: popcount-table-forgets-the-low-bit
why: table[i] = table[i / 2]: the lowest bit is never counted.

name: popcount-table-starts-at-two
why: the table starts at 2: table[1] stays 0.

name: popcount-only-the-low-byte
why: three bytes of the value are ignored.

name: popcount-top-byte-missing
why: the highest byte is ignored.

name: popcount-table-not-constexpr
why: a const table: it exists, but constant expressions cannot read it.

extraFiles.EXPECT_COMPILE_FAIL: This mutant is meant not to compile: the compiler rejects it, which is the point of the lesson.

name: sieve-marks-the-prime-itself
why: the multiples start at p, so p itself is crossed out.

name: sieve-forgets-zero-and-one-are-not-prime
why: the table starts at 0.

edits.old: for (std::size_t i = 2; i <= N; ++i) prime[i] = true;
edits.new: for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= N; ++i) prime[i] = true;

name: sieve-stops-too-early
why: p * p < N: the square of the last prime is never crossed out.

name: sieve-ignores-the-last-number
why: the table is filled up to N - 1 only.

edits.old: for (std::size_t i = 2; i <= N; ++i) prime[i] = true;
edits.new: for (std::size_t i = 2; i < N; ++i) prime[i] = true;

name: sieve-by-trial-division
why: every number is tested by dividing: correct, and far beyond the compiler's step limit.

extraFiles.EXPECT_COMPILE_FAIL: This mutant is meant not to compile: the compiler rejects it, which is the point of the lesson.

name: g-calls-wrong-start
why: g_calls starts at factorial(4).

name: g-calls-without-constinit
why: a plain global: it may be initialised at run time, in an unspecified order.

name: next-call-returns-the-old-value
why: post-increment.
